question: does a bigger labelled contrast pool move the fitted shared axis toward the published oracle direction?

estimator_test.method: mean_abs_cos over blk.9..35 x {axes_attn, axes_ffn} against q3-oracle-axes.pt, layers normalised

reading: 50% more prompts changed alignment by -0.0024, inside noise; the answer-span locus is ~7x worse than the prompt-last locus; and the current bad-minus-good contrast beats every simpler contrast built from the same records. The ceiling is in the estimator and the locus, not the sample count. Fitted q3-4B arms remain below the published oracle point; 'more data' is now an excluded hypothesis, not an open con.
